title: Customer retention and advocacy
definition: Users keep using the product, and recommend it, because it keeps proving useful and treats them well. Retention and advocacy are consequences to observe and understand, not levers to pull.
intended_outcome: The team understands why users stay or leave and fixes the cause; leaving, exporting and cancelling are honest and easy.
implementation_guidance: Treat retention and referrals as lagging indicators of value. When they fall, diagnose the cause from outcome data and user feedback before adding any prompt.
Data export and account closure are discoverable and work without contacting support. No hidden cancellation, confirm-shaming or guilt copy.
Referral and review requests appear only after a success the user can see, never as a gate, and offer no incentive for a positive rating.
Ask departing users why, optionally. Report only aggregates that meet the cohort floor in brain.community.md section 3, and nothing at person level.
A retention metric that rises when users are worse off (locked in, unable to export) is invalid. Pair every retention metric with an outcome metric.
Every engagement-related recommendation this engine produces is flagged requires_human_review.

automated: Presence checks that an export route and a cancellation route exist and are reachable (heuristic).
expert_review: Dark-pattern audit of cancellation, referral and review flows.
observed_behaviour: Cohort retention and leaving reasons from product data (cohort size recorded; no person-level reporting).
customer_feedback: Interviews, reviews and support feedback, labelled as customer feedback.

limitations: Retention depends on market, pricing and competition outside the interface.
No advocacy metric is adopted here. Choosing one is an open question.
Small products have cohorts too small to measure.

evidence.summary: Dot Intelligence Manifesto non-negotiable rule 3: ethical engagement only; optimise for learning, achievement, growth and progress, not addiction or screen time.
Users who are free to leave and who see real results are more likely to stay and to refer others.
evidence.rationale: A design stance; not measured on Dot products.

dopemine_constraint: Retention and advocacy are outcomes to understand, never levers to maximise. Engagement-mechanic metrics are not targets (brain.dopemine.md section 2); cancellation and export must stay honest and easy; every engagement-related recommendation requires human review before adoption.
